product_one_liner.value: WindBorne operates long-duration weather balloons and combines their atmospheric measurements with its WeatherMesh AI forecasts to help weather-impacted organizations—especially energy traders and utilities—make operational decisions.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes its balloon-and-forecast system and industry-tailored solutions for weather-impacted teams.
